answer: In PoA, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph. If a sybil cluster is separated by a sparse external cut, its low conductance limits probability flow from honest seed nodes; Cheeger-style escape bounds and min-cut transitivity bounds prevent fabricated local attestations from compounding across honest regions. Consequently, the cluster’s aggregate voting weight is mathematically capped, regardless of identifiers such as inlet, willow, or pigment.
